Hi Jordan & Camila —

Thanks again for the product tour last week. We left confident there's a strong fit between our service orchestration layer and Redwood's inference routing for marketplace integrations. Our GTM and engineering teams would like to run a joint technical workshop to:

- Align on architecture & integration patterns (auth, telemetry, failure modes)
- Walk through a staged demo (marketplace provisioning -> tenant onboarding -> live inference)
- Define next-step owner list and dates

Proposed timeframe: week of June 22 (we can be flexible). Typical format is a 2.5-hour working session with an optional one-hour follow-up deep-dive for the infra owners.

Do you have any preferred days/times? I'll also include our Marketplace partner lead Devon on thread to coordinate calendar and any procurement prep.

Thanks,
Elena Rossi
